description: This file declares the class ReadShmDataAndAttachSamples, which is a task in the generic namespace for the Rialto server's GStreamer player. It includes class members and methods related to reading shared memory data and attaching samples, and references several external interfaces and context objects.

classes.name: ReadShmDataAndAttachSamples
classes.description: A class representing a task to read shared memory data and attach samples in the Rialto GStreamer player.

methods.name: ReadShmDataAndAttachSamples
methods.description: Constructor initializing the task with context, player, and data reader references.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Method to perform the task's main operation of reading shared memory data and attaching samples.
